extraction.name: EgoLife Dataset
extraction.description: A comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset with intensive annotation, collected over a seven-day period with six participants living together in a custom-designed environment.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Six participants lived together for one week in a custom-designed environment (EgoHouse), continuously recording their daily activities using AI glasses (Meta Aria) for multimodal egocentric video capture, along with synchronized third-person-view video references from 15 GoPro cameras and millimeter-wave radars.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Experiments, Passive Data Collection, Direct measurement
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Due to storage limitations, recordings are structured into three-hour segments. Glasses are collected every three hours for data upload and storage clearance, taking approximately one hour. During this period, participants are instructed to remain in their rooms and limit activities to prevent logic disruptions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multimodal egocentric video and signals from Meta Aria glasses, third-person video from 15 GoPro cameras, spatial and motion data from millimeter-wave radars, and WiFi signals.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Synchronization of multi-source data (video, audio, IMU) from Aria glasses and GoPro cameras using EgoSync codebase.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Rigorous data cleaning including multi-view synchronization, de-identification (blurring faces/license plates, muting sensitive audio), and audio processing to mute sensitive information.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Transcripts: Speech recognition followed by diarization, then human review and refinement per participant track. Captions: Videos split into 5-minute clips, slowed to 0.8x speed; annotators provided continuous narrations converted to text and reviewed. QA: GPT-4o generated candidates from visual-audio captions; human annotators filtered (retaining questions requiring info from 5+ mins prior), refined, and generated distractors for multiple-choice questions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Questions were filtered based on requiring information from at least five minutes prior, with preference for longer dependencies and real-world relevance. Annotators also specified if audio was required and the look-back time (certification length).
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Whisper Large v3, open-source diarization algorithm, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4o
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Ongoing project; plan to expand the dataset to cover a broader range of languages, locations, and activities. Milan dataset collected and to be detailed in upcoming blog series.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Faces, vehicle license plates, audio containing private or identifiable information, screen content (passwords, personal data).
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential to enhance human-AI interaction in personalized assistance, improving quality of life for the elderly or those with cognitive challenges. Raises privacy and ethical considerations regarding integration into personal spaces.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Limited generalizability due to single language (Chinese) and scenario (single house).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Sacrificing generalizability (single language/scenario). EgoGPT struggles with speech understanding (laughter/emotions) and overfits to early observations. EgoRAG lacks multi-step reasoning.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Fine Tuning. Specifically for long-context, life-oriented question-answering, recalling past events, monitoring health habits, and personalized recommendations.
